## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 6 captures during August 2022. This report summarises the activity completed during the month and the outcome of the subsequent image review. The activity total provides the basis for considering image quality and grading performance at the site.

## Image quality

Of the 6 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 16.7. The ungradable capture could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately from the captures that proceeded through the grading process. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 0 referable results for the reporting period. The median lag from capture to grading was 10. This provides the central measure of the time taken for images to move from capture to a completed grading outcome. Overall, the report records the site’s activity, the number of ungradable captures, the ungradable rate, the referable result count, and the median grading lag for August 2022.
